title: sabina horizontalis f. douglasii
intro: Sabina horizontalis f. douglasii, commonly known as Douglas fir, is a plant species in the Pinaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Douglas fir include reducing pain, stress, and anxiety, while also acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Douglas fir include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
